thread:
Maya (AE): urgent — Pegasus Edge legal just flagged three blockers in the SQ: 1) no outbound egress to non-approved regions, 2) mandatory SSO via their IdP for all test accounts, 3) require SOC2 Type II report before demo. POC is paused until we answer.
Rishi (Solutions Eng): copy. egress constraint = can we restrict egress to eu-west only? yes via NAT/egress ACLs on Private. need their allowed IP ranges.
Claire (Security): SOC2: we can share our most recent SOC2 report under NDA. for SSO we support SAML/OIDC. we'll need their metadata and an SP-initiated flow for the demo.
Hank (Platform): infra note: lockdown to specific egress subnets + SSO config is doable. provisioning a Private demo with these controls ~48h if prioritized. will need service account and SAML metadata from customer.
Jo (Sales Lead): timeframe? customer wants sign-off within 72 hours or they'll reschedule on-site. escalate to execs if we can't meet.
Maya (AE): I'll ask for their allowed egress IPs + SAML metadata in the next customer thread. can Legal prep the SOC2 sharing NDA?
legal-bot: suggest using standard CDA template + limited-use SOC2 disclosure addendum. avoid sharing sensitive logs. legal can turn around draft in <8h if prioritized.
Eddie (Finance): FYI: Private demo will likely change pricing. estimate ~20-30% uplift for reserved demo capacity + ops support. need quick quote approval.
Rishi (Solutions Eng): I'll assemble a short demo runbook: network diagram, SSO steps, egress controls, and sample commands to validate.
Claire (Security): action items: Claire prepare SOC2 sharing checklist; Hank prepare 48h provisioning plan + ops windows; Rishi tech runbook; Maya request customer artifacts; Jo loop finance & exec sponsor.
Maya (AE): scheduling exec bridge now for tomorrow 09:00 PT with Pegasus CIO + our Security + Platform. sending invite after legal confirms NDA draft. will post calendar link here.
Jo (Sales Lead): thanks — let's treat this high priority. if Legal or Finance can't meet timeline, flag here immediately. :thumbsup:
